name: v4.6.0
body:
## What's Changed
* fix(comments): spend TikTok and Instagram comment calls on posts the report keeps by @mvanhorn in https://github.com/mvanhorn/last30days-skill/pull/1554
* feat(tiktok): free top comments for every kept TikTok from the public comment endpoint by @mvanhorn in https://github.com/mvanhorn/last30days-skill/pull/1555
* feat(library): silent multi-harness finished-brief capture and offline transcript harvest by @mvanhorn in https://github.com/mvanhorn/last30days-skill/pull/1556
* feat(shortform): keyless TikTok/Instagram fallback via web discovery + yt-dlp by @grain-lu in https://github.com/mvanhorn/last30days-skill/pull/1533
* chore(release): bump version to 4.6.0 by @github-actions[bot] in https://github.com/mvanhorn/last30days-skill/pull/1559

## New Contributors
* @grain-lu made their first contribution in https://github.com/mvanhorn/last30days-skill/pull/1533

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/mvanhorn/last30days-skill/compare/v4.5.0...v4.6.0
